items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I'm reminded of this uh Helmecki who was a very famous bass drummer around he played with uh John Philip Sousa

ctx.x: were there any outstanding bass drum players for example in the parades

no but that is really interesting because I'm reminded of this uh Helmecki who was a very famous bass drummer around he played with uh John Philip Sousa his contention was that a bass drummer was a musician and if he was a good pianist and knew the chords and knew the construction of tunes he'd be ever so much better off but great difficulty was that most of them went along for the ride so at bass drum all you have to do is carry the instrument and hit it once in a while
I've heard people mention Emil Gonzalez and different fellows I just wondered if they I didn't know him no I wondered if they did any fancy drumming in your day on the bass drumming parade
